_note: Stage 3 fix. A framework named in a posting asserts its language even when the language is never written. This was the single largest recall loss: JavaScript was missed 6 times because postings say React or Node.js and never say JavaScript.
_scope: Deliberately narrow. Only implications where the language is unavoidable to use the framework. NOT included: MySQL -> SQL (the Stage 3 labeller consistently did not treat naming a database product as naming SQL), and WordPress -> PHP (a WordPress role often needs no PHP authoring).
